properties.displayName: QC - Critical Threat Detected from Carbon Black Alerts
properties.description: This creates an incident in the event a critical threat was identified on a Carbon Black managed endpoint.
properties.query:
let queryFrequency = ago(1h);
let threshold = 8;
CarbonBlackNotifications_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= queryFrequency
| where threatInfo_score_d >= threshold
| project 
       TimeGenerated,
       Severity = deviceInfo_targetPriorityType_s,
       ThreatScore = threatInfo_score_d,
       Summary = threatInfo_summary_s,
       ThreatCategory = threatInfo_threatCause_threatCategory_s,
       Actor = threatInfo_threatCause_actorName_s,
       ActorHash = threatInfo_threatCause_actor_s,
       ProcessID = threatInfo_threatCause_actorProcessPPid_s,
       ThreatIndicators = threatInfo_indicators_s,
       ThreatCauseReputation= threatInfo_threatCause_reputation_s,
       HostName = tostring(split(deviceInfo_deviceName_s, '\\')[1]) ,
       HostId = deviceInfo_deviceId_d,
       IpAddr = deviceInfo_internalIpAddress_s,
       HostType = deviceInfo_deviceType_s,
       HostOS = deviceInfo_deviceVersion_s,
       HostGroup = deviceInfo_groupName_s,
       NTDomain = tostring(split(deviceInfo_email_s, '\\')[0]),
       UserName = tostring(split(deviceInfo_email_s, '\\')[1]),
       IncidentID = threatInfo_incidentId_g,
       AlertLink = url_s
